description: Fresh-chat auto-invocation prompts. Project prompts come verbatim from COMPATIBILITY.md and never mention Tandem, the workspace, or MCP. Controls are unrelated to any project; tool calls are not wanted there. Prompts with "conflict": true get the harness's teammate injector, and prompts with "folders" get the fixtures FOLDER_SEED tree and a folder grader (see run.mjs).

prompts.text: Draft a one-page brief for our launch plan that I can share with the team.
prompts.expected: sync, then create_document or ask before publishing

prompts.text: What's our current project goal, and who owns which parts?
Write this week's status update for the project.
We've decided to cut the mobile app from v1. Can you record that?
Tighten up the intro section of our spec.
prompts.expected: sync; read_file then update_document with expected_version

prompts.text: Tighten the intro paragraph of our project brief and save the change.
prompts.expected: read_file, update_document hits VERSION_CONFLICT (teammate edit injected), re-read, merge keeping the teammate's line, retry once

prompts.text: Read our project brief, then create a new shared document named client-check.md containing a three-bullet summary of it. You have my permission to save this document for the team.
prompts.expected: read_file, then successful create_document; a duplicate name on later persistent-server repetitions may require a new name

prompts.text: Save notes from today's standup for the team: Sam shipped the version history panel, Alex finished the OAuth flow, Priya has no blockers. You have my permission to save this document for the team.
prompts.expected: list_files/sync shows /meeting-notes; create_document with folder_path "/meeting-notes" (or its parent_id), not the root

prompts.text: Start a retrospective doc for this sprint in a new retros folder, with sections for what went well, what didn't, and action items. You have my permission to save it for the team.
prompts.expected: create_folder { path: "/retros" }, then create_document with folder_path "/retros"

prompts.text: What rate limit does our API spec at /specs/api-spec.md set for clients?
prompts.expected: read_file { path: "/specs/api-spec.md" } (or its file_id); answer states 120 requests per minute
